## 1) What the software application is and does

The goals describe a **digital reading application optimized for students** that runs on a **tablet** and supports **online and document-based reading** (web articles, news from official sources, PDFs, eBooks). It helps users **collect, store, organize, and access reading materials** (especially course materials) across **multiple cloud/storage providers**, and it supports **low-friction import/export flows** (e.g., export directly to cloud storage or an e-reader account without extra downloading/uploading). The app also supports **reading progress/time estimates** and workflow for **instructor-assigned readings** in a school setting.

## 2) Goal-by-goal meaning (what it means here, and what it does *not* intend)

- **g0 Read books and articles digitally**  
  Means: users consume reading materials electronically in the app ecosystem.  
  Not intended: printing workflows or physical book logistics.

- **g1 Read on a tablet instead of a computer**  
  Means: primary UX is tablet-first; features support tablet reading contexts.  
  Not intended: fully replacing desktop authoring/annotation suites.

- **g2 Avoid a cumbersome online reading experience**  
  Means: reduce friction (too many steps, tool switching, hard-to-read pages, awkward downloads/exports).  
  Not intended: guaranteeing perfect performance on every website; it’s about the app experience.

- **g3 Maintain focus while reading**  
  Means: reading UI supports immersion/progress cues and reduces context switching.  
  Not intended: blocking all distractions outside the app (e.g., OS notifications).

- **g4 Access and read public web content online**  
  Means: open/read publicly accessible pages/articles directly, without manual file handling.  
  Not intended: bypassing paywalls or accessing private content without permission.

- **g5 Provide a dedicated method for online reading in a school setting**  
  Means: support classroom workflows: instructor distribution, student access, course materials persistence.  
  Not intended: full LMS replacement (grading, attendance, etc.).

- **g6 Read news online from official sources**  
  Means: reading news content via official publishers/sites/apps, likely via web.  
  Not intended: user-generated rumor sources or unofficial reposts.

- **g7 Store books and course materials in a personal online library.**  
  Means: a user-centric library in the app that indexes/organizes materials.  
  Not intended: a public shared repository for all users by default.

- **g8 Store library content across multiple storage providers.**  
  Means: integrate with multiple clouds (e.g., Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive) while presenting unified library.  
  Not intended: acting as a storage provider itself (though it may cache).

- **g9 Access previously stored course materials after a course or semester ends.**  
  Means: keep personal access even after course portals close.  
  Not intended: retaining materials the student never had rights to keep.

- **g10 Use free-trial access to read news content without paying for an ongoing subscription**  
  Means: leverage legitimate trial offers to read; manage trial-based access.  
  Not intended: piracy or circumventing subscriptions beyond allowed trials.

- **g11 Access reading materials without needing to download and upload them**  
  Means: enable direct-open / direct-export flows from sources to reading/storage destinations.  
  Not intended: forbidding downloads entirely—just avoiding needless steps.

- **g12 Download course-related PDF documents from web pages and course portals**  
  Means: acquire PDFs from course sites/portals into the user’s library/storage.  
  Not intended: scraping restricted portals without credentials/authorization.

- **g13 Open and read PDF and eBook documents in a single interface**  
  Means: unified reader UI for PDFs and eBooks (and likely articles).  
  Not intended: full editing/desktop publishing.

- **g14 Manage PDF documents**  
  Means: organize/rename/tag/move/delete, possibly annotate; basic document management.  
  Not intended: advanced PDF creation or heavy content editing.

- **g15 Export PDF documents to another document reader**  
  Means: send/share PDFs out to other apps/services.  
  Not intended: guaranteeing interoperability with every reader app.

- **g16 Open documents, including PDF files, on a tablet**  
  Means: tablet-compatible opening/rendering flows.  
  Not intended: desktop-only workflows.

- **g17 Import course content to a tablet with fewer steps**  
  Means: reduce friction getting materials from portals/web into tablet reading.  
  Not intended: eliminating all user confirmation/security steps.

- **g18 Store downloaded documents in personal file storage.**  
  Means: keep local or cloud “personal storage” copies under user control.  
  Not intended: storing only in transient cache.

- **g19 Download reading materials to personal file storage.**  
  Means: support downloading/saving to the user’s chosen storage location.  
  Not intended: always-online only.

- **g20 Export assigned reading materials directly to online storage without downloading them to a computer first.**  
  Means: direct-to-cloud save from source; supports mobile/tablet-first.  
  Not intended: requiring a desktop intermediary.

- **g21 Export content to a cloud storage location.**  
  Means: integrate export/share to cloud services.  
  Not intended: single-provider lock-in.

- **g22 Export content to an e-reader account.**  
  Means: send to Kindle/other e-reader ecosystems.  
  Not intended: forcing users to use an e-reader account.

- **g23 Consolidate all reading materials into a single location**  
  Means: unify access via library/aggregated index even if files live in multiple providers.  
  Not intended: physically moving every file into one storage provider.

- **g24 View the percentage of completion for the current chapter**  
  Means: progress indicator within reader for structured content (ebooks/PDF chapters if detectable).  
  Not intended: perfect chapter detection for arbitrary PDFs.

- **g25 View the estimated time remaining to finish the current chapter**  
  Means: reading-time estimate based on progress/reading speed.  
  Not intended: medically accurate time prediction.

- **g26 Save valuable documents and resources for later access**  
  Means: bookmarking/archiving items into the library for future retrieval.  
  Not intended: long-term preservation guarantees beyond storage provider policies.

- **g27 Categorize resources by time period and enable filtering or searching by month or year, including for saved resources based on when they were read**  
  Means: time-based organization and search (saved/read timestamps).  
  Not intended: full research citation management.

- **g28 Access assigned school articles in a single online location on a tablet**  
  Means: a consolidated assigned-reading feed/view for students on tablet.  
  Not intended: instructor authoring of new articles.

- **g29 Receive assigned articles from instructors**  
  Means: instructor-to-student distribution mechanism (links/PDFs).  
  Not intended: grading/assessment, though it could integrate.

- **g30 Present a project proposal to an instructor**  
  Means: a school workflow element; likely tangential but could be part of the same “course workspace.”  
  Not intended: full project management system.

### 1) What the software application is and does
This goal set describes a **digital reading and study workflow application optimized for tablet use (especially in school)**. It helps students (and other readers) **access public web content and official news online**, **collect and organize course PDFs/eBooks and web articles into a personal online library**, **sync that library across multiple storage providers**, and **read everything in a single, distraction-minimizing interface**. It also supports **assignment distribution from instructors**, **exporting materials to cloud storage or e-reader accounts**, and **progress/time tracking to help maintain reading focus**.

---

### 2) Goal-by-goal meaning in this application context (including intent/non-intent)

**g0 Read books and articles digitally**  
- Means: The overall outcome of using the app: consume long-form reading content electronically.  
- Not intended: Writing original books/articles or doing general web browsing unrelated to reading.

**g1 Read on a tablet instead of a computer**  
- Means: Tablet-first UX (touch, larger reading surface, mobility).  
- Not intended: Replacing all computer tasks; it’s specifically about the reading experience.

**g2 Avoid a cumbersome online reading experience**  
- Means: Reduce friction: fewer clicks, fewer downloads/uploads, fewer tool switches.  
- Not intended: Solving every usability issue on the internet; focused on reading workflow.

**g3 Maintain focus while reading**  
- Means: Support sustained reading (progress indicators, time remaining, unified reader).  
- Not intended: Clinical attention treatment; only product features that reduce distraction.

**g4 Access and read public web content online**  
- Means: Open and read web articles directly in the app (reader mode / dedicated flow).  
- Not intended: Accessing paywalled/private content illegally.

**g5 Provide a dedicated method for online reading in a school setting**  
- Means: A school-oriented reading workflow (assignments, course materials, tablet access).  
- Not intended: Full learning management system replacement (grading, attendance, etc.).

**g6 Read news online from official sources**  
- Means: Read publisher/official outlet content (potentially within trial windows).  
- Not intended: Aggregating pirated copies; “official” implies legitimate access paths.

**g7 Store books and course materials in a personal online library.**  
- Means: Central personal repository/collection inside the app, backed by online storage.  
- Not intended: Public sharing library or institutional repository.

**g8 Store library content across multiple storage providers.**  
- Means: Connect/sync to multiple clouds (e.g., Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox).  
- Not intended: Building a new storage provider; rather integrating with existing ones.

**g9 Access previously stored course materials after a course or semester ends.**  
- Means: Retain access even after a course portal closes; personal continuity.  
- Not intended: Bypassing school access controls; relies on user’s legitimately saved copies.

**g10 Use free-trial access to read news content without paying for an ongoing subscription**  
- Means: Support trial-based reading flows (account linking, reminders, etc.).  
- Not intended: Circumventing paywalls beyond what trials legally allow.

**g11 Access reading materials without needing to download and upload them**  
- Means: “Direct export/import” flows from web/portal to cloud/library without manual file juggling.  
- Not intended: Eliminating all downloads forever; some sources may require download.

**g12 Download course-related PDF documents from web pages and course portals**  
- Means: Capture PDFs from course sites and store them for reading.  
- Not intended: Downloading unrelated executables/media; constrained to course PDFs.

**g13 Open and read PDF and eBook documents in a single interface**  
- Means: Unified reader for PDFs and eBooks (epub/kindle formats where possible).  
- Not intended: Full authoring/editing suite.

**g14 Manage PDF documents**  
- Means: Organize, rename, move, tag, delete, perhaps annotate (depending on scope).  
- Not intended: Advanced PDF editing (redaction, form design) unless specified.

**g15 Export PDF documents to another document reader**  
- Means: Interoperate with other apps (share/open-in).  
- Not intended: Replacing those readers.

**g16 Open documents, including PDF files, on a tablet**  
- Means: Tablet compatibility for stored/imported documents.  
- Not intended: Desktop-only workflows.

**g17 Import course content to a tablet with fewer steps**  
- Means: Streamlined pipeline to get course materials onto the tablet quickly.  
- Not intended: Eliminating authentication/security steps required by the school.

**g18 Store downloaded documents in personal file storage.**  
- Means: Persist files in user-chosen storage (cloud drive, file system).  
- Not intended: Only temporary caching.

**g19 Download reading materials to personal file storage.**  
- Means: Save copies locally/in cloud for later reading.  
- Not intended: Automatically downloading everything without user intent.

**g20 Export assigned reading materials directly to online storage without downloading them to a computer first.**  
- Means: One-step “send to cloud/library” from assignment source.  
- Not intended: Requires a computer; explicitly avoids that.

**g21 Export content to a cloud storage location.**  
- Means: Send to connected storage providers.  
- Not intended: Only within the app; it explicitly targets external storage.

**g22 Export content to an e-reader account.**  
- Means: Push to Kindle/other e-reader services.  
- Not intended: Guaranteeing delivery if e-reader service rejects formats.

**g23 Consolidate all reading materials into a single location**  
- Means: A unified library view across sources/providers.  
- Not intended: Physically migrating all data to one provider; can be a unified index.

**g24 View the percentage of completion for the current chapter**  
- Means: Progress tracking to support motivation/focus.  
- Not intended: Accurate for every PDF (chapter boundaries may be inferred/limited).

**g25 View the estimated time remaining to finish the current chapter**  
- Means: Reading-time estimation to plan study sessions.  
- Not intended: Perfect accuracy; it’s an estimate.

**g26 Save valuable documents and resources for later access**  
- Means: Bookmark/save web articles and docs into the library for later.  
- Not intended: General-purpose note-taking app (unless extended).

**g27 Categorize resources by time period and enable filtering or searching by month or year, including for saved resources based on when they were read**  
- Means: Organization and retrieval by time (read date/saved date).  
- Not intended: Full semantic search across content body unless specified.

**g28 Access assigned school articles in a single online location on a tablet**  
- Means: Central assignment feed/library accessible on tablet.  
- Not intended: Accessing assignments without being enrolled/authorized.

**g29 Receive assigned articles from instructors**  
- Means: Instructor-to-student distribution mechanism (links/files/reading list).  
- Not intended: Two-way classroom chat; it’s specifically assignment delivery.

**g30 Present a project proposal to an instructor**  
- Means: A workflow step related to getting approval for using/proposing the tool or a project in class.  
- Not intended: Full project management system.

## 1) What the software application is and does

The goals describe a **tablet-first digital reading hub for students (and general readers)** that helps users **access public web content and official news**, **collect course PDFs and articles**, **store them in an online library across cloud providers**, and **read them in a focused, dedicated interface**. It also supports **getting assigned readings from instructors**, consolidating them in one place, tracking reading progress, and exporting/importing content to storage or e-reader accounts with fewer steps (ideally without manual download/upload).

## 2) Goal-by-goal meaning (including intent and non-intent)

- **g0 Read books and articles digitally**  
  *Means:* The user wants to consume reading materials electronically rather than on paper.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t specify device, source, or storage method.

- **g1 Read on a tablet instead of a computer**  
  *Means:* Primary reading device is a tablet; UI and workflows should be tablet-friendly.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t exclude occasional computer use; just expresses preference.

- **g2 Avoid a cumbersome online reading experience**  
  *Means:* Reduce friction: too many clicks, browser clutter, multiple apps, repeated logins, etc.  
  *Not intended:* Not purely about speed; it’s about simplicity and smoothness.

- **g3 Maintain focus while reading**  
  *Means:* Reduce distractions (notifications, ads, tab switching), provide a “reading mode.”  
  *Not intended:* Not about studying techniques or assessment; it’s about reading attention.

- **g4 Access and read public web content online**  
  *Means:* Read web pages/articles directly (not only PDFs/eBooks), likely via an in-app reader.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t imply paywalled content access or scraping.

- **g5 Provide a dedicated method for online reading in a school setting**  
  *Means:* School-oriented workflow: assigned readings, course materials, classroom context.  
  *Not intended:* Not a full LMS replacement; focuses on reading experience/collection.

- **g6 Read news online from official sources**  
  *Means:* Access reputable publishers/sites directly.  
  *Not intended:* Not about social feeds or user-generated news.

- **g7 Store books and course materials in a personal online library.**  
  *Means:* Central library concept where the user’s reading items live across time.  
  *Not intended:* Not necessarily a public/shared library.

- **g8 Store library content across multiple storage providers.**  
  *Means:* Integrations with multiple clouds (e.g., Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive).  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t mean duplication everywhere; could mean user choice per item.

- **g9 Access previously stored course materials after a course or semester ends.**  
  *Means:* Long-term retention and retrieval; materials remain accessible later.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t guarantee institution licenses continue; focuses on stored items.

- **g10 Use free-trial access to read news content without paying for an ongoing subscription**  
  *Means:* Support trials (or trial management) so users can read without committing.  
  *Not intended:* Not about bypassing paywalls illegally; assumes legitimate trial access.

- **g11 Access reading materials without needing to download and upload them**  
  *Means:* Stream/transfer directly between sources and storage/reader; avoid manual file handling.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t forbid caching for offline use; just avoids manual steps.

- **g12 Download course-related PDF documents from web pages and course portals**  
  *Means:* Ability to fetch PDFs from course sites/portals and web pages.  
  *Not intended:* Not a guarantee of bypassing authentication; assumes authorized access.

- **g13 Open and read PDF and eBook documents in a single interface**  
  *Means:* One reader UI for multiple formats; consistent experience.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t require full editing; primarily reading.

- **g14 Manage PDF documents**  
  *Means:* Organize, rename, tag, delete, maybe annotate or reorder.  
  *Not intended:* Not necessarily advanced PDF authoring.

- **g15 Export PDF documents to another document reader**  
  *Means:* Interoperability: send out to another app/service if preferred.  
  *Not intended:* Not a replacement for other readers; complements them.

- **g16 Open documents, including PDF files, on a tablet**  
  *Means:* Tablet compatibility for PDFs and related docs (viewer + file access).  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t imply desktop parity; focus is tablet.

- **g17 Import course content to a tablet with fewer steps**  
  *Means:* Simplify getting content onto tablet (direct import, fewer transfers).  
  *Not intended:* Not only for PDFs; “course content” can include articles.

- **g18 Store downloaded documents in personal file storage.**  
  *Means:* Save acquired files into the user’s chosen storage (cloud/personal).  
  *Not intended:* Not necessarily local-only; “personal file storage” can be cloud.

- **g19 Download reading materials to personal file storage.**  
  *Means:* Acquisition pipeline into storage (download/save).  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t require that reading must be offline; it’s about saving.

- **g20 Export assigned reading materials directly to online storage without downloading them to a computer first.**  
  *Means:* Direct-to-cloud export from assignment/source; avoid PC as middle step.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t necessarily avoid downloading entirely (could still transfer), but avoids manual PC handling.

- **g21 Export content to a cloud storage location.**  
  *Means:* Generic capability to export into cloud folders/providers.  
  *Not intended:* Doesn’t specify which provider.

- **g22 Export content to an e-reader account.**

  *Not intended:* Not necessarily every e-reader; could be selected integrations.

- **g24 View the percentage of completion for the current chapter**

- **g25 View the estimated time remaining to finish the current chapter**

## 1) What the software application is and does

The goals describe a **digital reading workflow application**, optimized for **students (and other readers) who read web articles, news, PDFs, and eBooks**, especially on a **tablet**. The app acts as a **single reading hub** that can: (a) open and manage reading documents in one interface, (b) collect and store course and personal reading materials in a personal online library, (c) move content between web sources, cloud storage providers, and e-reader accounts with minimal steps, and (d) support focused reading with progress/time indicators and later retrieval.

In a school context, it also supports a **dedicated channel for instructors to assign articles**, and for students to access those assignments in one place on a tablet.

## 2) Goal-by-goal meaning (in context), including intent and non-intent

- **g0 Read books and articles digitally**  
  *Means*: The overall outcome of using the app is to read content in digital form (web, PDFs, eBooks).  
  *Not intended*: Doesn’t specify device, source, storage, or learning outcomes—just the digital reading state.

- **g1 Read on a tablet instead of a computer**  
  *Means*: The app supports (and prefers) tablet usage for reading activities.  
  *Not intended*: Not a ban on computers; rather a focus on tablet as the primary reading surface.

- **g2 Avoid a cumbersome online reading experience**  
  *Means*: Reduce friction (too many steps, scattered systems, awkward flows) when reading online content.  
  *Not intended*: Not about offline reading performance or visual design specifics unless they reduce friction.

- **g3 Maintain focus while reading**  
  *Means*: Features should help sustain attention (progress/time remaining, unified reading interface, fewer context switches).  
  *Not intended*: Not clinical attention management; not guaranteeing learning outcomes.

- **g4 Access and read public web content online**  
  *Means*: Ability to read freely available web pages/articles directly.  
  *Not intended*: Not necessarily scraping paywalled content; public web content implies accessible pages.

- **g5 Provide a dedicated method for online reading in a school setting**  
  *Means*: A school-oriented workflow: instructors assign readings, students access them centrally, ideally on tablets.  
  *Not intended*: Full LMS replacement (grading, attendance) unless required for reading flow.

- **g6 Read news online from official sources**  
  *Means*: Access news content from publisher/official sites (not reposts).  
  *Not intended*: Not general social media news; not necessarily aggregating from unofficial blogs.

- **g7 Store books and course materials in a personal online library.**  
  *Means*: A user’s personal library that persists and organizes their reading materials.  
  *Not intended*: A public library sharing platform; emphasis is personal.

- **g8 Store library content across multiple storage providers.**  
  *Means*: The personal library can be backed by multiple clouds (e.g., Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox).  
  *Not intended*: Building a new storage provider; it’s integration/connection.

- **g9 Access previously stored course materials after a course or semester ends.**  
  *Means*: Materials remain available beyond the course portal’s lifecycle.  
  *Not intended*: Rights bypass; assumes the user is allowed to keep/access materials.

- **g10 Use free-trial access to read news content without paying for an ongoing subscription**  
  *Means*: Support lawful trial-based access flows (e.g., sign-in/trial management) to read official news.  
  *Not intended*: Circumventing paywalls illegally.

- **g11 Access reading materials without needing to download and upload them**  
  *Means*: Streamline “save/export” workflows (direct to cloud/e-reader) rather than manual download then upload.  
  *Not intended*: Eliminating downloads entirely—some content may still require download.

- **g12 Download course-related PDF documents from web pages and course portals**  
  *Means*: The app can retrieve PDFs from course pages/portals.  
  *Not intended*: Not necessarily handling all portal authentication edge cases unless needed.

- **g13 Open and read PDF and eBook documents in a single interface**  
  *Means*: Unified reading interface across formats.  
  *Not intended*: Full authoring/editor suite; reading-first.

- **g14 Manage PDF documents**  
  *Means*: Organize PDFs (rename, tag, move, delete, maybe annotate) within the app/library.  
  *Not intended*: Heavy PDF editing (layout changes) unless implied by “manage.”

- **g15 Export PDF documents to another document reader**  
  *Means*: Interoperability—send PDFs out to other apps.  
  *Not intended*: Replacing other readers; rather enabling handoff.

- **g16 Open documents, including PDF files, on a tablet**  
  *Means*: Tablet-friendly opening/reading of files.  
  *Not intended*: Only PDFs; includes other document formats too.

- **g17 Import course content to a tablet with fewer steps**  
  *Means*: Reduce friction from course portal/web to tablet reading environment.  
  *Not intended*: Not necessarily automation without user permission; just fewer steps.

- **g18 Store downloaded documents in personal file storage.**  
  *Means*: When downloads occur, they are placed into user-controlled storage (cloud/local).  
  *Not intended*: Storing only inside app sandbox with no portability (unless that counts as personal storage).

- **g19 Download reading materials to personal file storage.**  
  *Means*: Capability to download and save reading items into that personal storage.  
  *Not intended*: Duplicating for piracy; assumes legitimate use.

- **g20 Export assigned reading materials directly to online storage without downloading them to a computer first.**  
  *Means*: Direct export from school assignment sources to cloud storage, skipping PC-based steps.  
  *Not intended*: Removing the need for any device; just avoiding the computer as intermediate step.

- **g21 Export content to a cloud storage location.**  
  *Means*: Export destination includes cloud drives.  
  *Not intended*: Only one provider; can be multiple.

- **g22 Export content to an e-reader account.**  
  *Means*: Send to Kindle/other e-reader accounts/services.  
  *Not intended*: Managing e-reader hardware; just account-based delivery.

- **g23 Consolidate all reading materials into a single location**  
  *Means*: Central hub/library view regardless of original source.  
  *Not intended*: Physically moving files always; could be linked/indexed.

- **g24 View the percentage of completion for the current chapter**  
  *Means*: Reading progress indicator.  
  *Not intended*: Academic grading; just progress through content.

- **g25 View the estimated time remaining to finish the current chapter**  
  *Means*: Time-to-finish estimation to support planning/focus.  
  *Not intended*: Perfect accuracy; estimation based on reading speed.

- **g26 Save valuable documents and resources for later access**  
  *Means*: Bookmark/save workflow for later retrieval.  
  *Not intended*: Necessarily full citation management; just saving.

- **g27 Categorize resources by time period and enable filtering or searching by month or year, including for saved resources based on when they were read**  
  *Means*: Time-based organization and retrieval (read date, saved date).  
  *Not intended*: Complex analytics; primarily filtering/search.

- **g28 Access assigned school articles in a single online location on a tablet**  
  *Means*: Student view of assigned readings, centralized, tablet-friendly.  
  *Not intended*: Instructor tooling (that’s more g29/g30) except as required.

- **g29 Receive assigned articles from instructors**  
  *Means*: Delivery mechanism for assignments into the app.  
  *Not intended*: The instructor authoring content; just assigning/sharing links/docs.

- **g30 Present a project proposal to an instructor**  
  *Means*: A school workflow where a student submits a proposal—likely related to reading/research project context.  
  *Not intended*: Full project management; primarily submission/presentation flow.

## Goal-by-goal meaning in this application (what it includes / excludes)

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
  *Means:* users can follow/monitor worldwide happenings and trends via the app’s content/feed. *Not intended:* being a professional newsroom; it’s consumption/awareness, not verified journalism by default.

- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
  *Means:* synchronous or near-real-time messaging/chat. *Not intended:* asynchronous posting only; also not necessarily voice/video calling unless specified.

- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
  *Means:* quick media posting/sending to friends. *Not intended:* professional media editing or long-form hosting guarantees.

- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**  
  *Means:* status updates/check-ins/short posts about day-to-day. *Not intended:* formal diaries or quantified-self tracking.

- **g4 Explain what social content and posts are**  
  *Means:* onboarding/help text defining posts/content. *Not intended:* content moderation policy details (unless added).

- **g5 Share non-verbal social updates**  
  *Means:* reactions, stickers, emojis, GIFs, quick signals. *Not intended:* long textual explanations.

- **g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed**  
  *Means:* feed personalization prioritizing a chosen person (e.g., “show me X first”). *Not intended:* guaranteeing *only* that person’s content shows.

- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
  *Means:* users can interact without revealing real identity (pseudonyms, limited profile exposure). *Not intended:* evading enforcement for abuse; may still require backend accountability.

- **g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations**  
  *Means:* privacy controls and security to stop unauthorized reads/uses. *Not intended:* eliminating all data processing; legitimate processing may still occur.

- **g9 Find answers to questions or issues**  
  *Means:* Q&A/discussion feature supports problem solving. *Not intended:* guaranteed correctness.

- **g10 View responses to a specific question**  
  *Means:* see answers/comments for a given question. *Not intended:* ranking/quality filtering unless specified elsewhere.

- **g11 Help other people by answering their questions**  
  *Means:* users contribute answers in threads/groups. *Not intended:* paid support obligations.

- **g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience**  
  *Means:* discover users with certain expertise/experience and contact them. *Not intended:* verifying credentials or employment history.

- **g13 Request that an interviewer repeat a question**  
  *Means:* a very specific interaction flow (possibly in chat/interview practice context). *Not intended:* audio transcription; it’s a “request repeat” action.

- **g14 Find a recipe**  
  *Means:* search/discover recipe content (posts/links). *Not intended:* grocery ordering or nutrition planning.

- **g15 Locate nearby places in a city where a specific item can be obtained**  
  *Means:* local search/places recommendations. *Not intended:* real-time inventory accuracy.

- **g16 Receive advertisements tailored to intended purchases**  
  *Means:* ad targeting toward purchase intent. *Not intended:* targeting via private conversations if prohibited by other goals.

- **g17 Purchase an item**

- **g18 Get recommendations for top restaurants in a city**

- **g19 Limit the number of times a person is shown advertisements for the same product**  
  *Means:* frequency capping. *Not intended:* removing ads entirely.

- **g20 Join groups based on shared interests**

- **g21 Ask questions within interest-based groups**

  *Means:* account takeover prevention. *Not intended:* preventing the owner from delegating access (unless prohibited).

- **g26 Prevent user-generated posts from disappearing unless the user deletes or archives them.**  
  *Means:* persistence/durability of posts. *Not intended:* preventing moderation removals (unless policy says otherwise).

- **g27 Ensure users do not miss relevant content items while browsing.**  
  *Means:* feed UX/ranking/refresh helps users see important content. *Not intended:* guaranteeing every item is seen.

- **g28 Ensure users remain aware of major events.**  
  *Means:* major-event surfacing/alerts/trending module. *Not intended:* emergency alert system compliance.

- **g29 Reduce the frequency of service outages.**  
  *Means:* reliability/availability engineering. *Not intended:* zero downtime guarantee.

- **g30 Load new items within an acceptable time frame.**  
  *Means:* performance latency targets for feed/search/thread loads. *Not intended:* offline mode.

- **g31 Automatically populate all required information.**

## Goal-by-goal meaning in this context (what it means / does not mean)

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
  Means the app helps users follow global happenings and what’s trending. Not necessarily investigative journalism or fact-checking by itself.

- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
  Means real-time chat/DMs or live messaging. Not necessarily voice/video calling.

- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
  Means fast media sharing in posts/messages. Not professional editing or long-form hosting guarantees.

- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**  
  Means quick status updates/check-ins. Not a quantified-self health tracker.

- **g4 Explain what social content and posts are**  
  Means onboarding/help text defining posts/content. Not enforcing content policy.

- **g5 Share non-verbal social updates**  
  Means reactions, stickers, emojis, photos, etc. Not replacing full messaging.

- **g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed**  
  Means a person-centric view/filter or prioritization. Not necessarily guaranteeing all posts are shown.

- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
  Means ability to participate without revealing identity (pseudonyms/anonymous mode). Not absolute anonymity against law enforcement/abuse investigations.

- **g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations**  
  Means access control, security, and privacy protections. Not promising zero data collection.

- **g9 Find answers to questions or issues**  
  Means Q&A/discussion search and browsing to get solutions. Not professional advice guarantees.

- **g10 View responses to a specific question**  
  Means seeing answers/comments thread. Not ensuring quality/correctness.

- **g11 Help other people by answering their questions**  
  Means the app supports contributing answers. Not requiring every user to participate.

- **g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience**

The goals describe a **consumer social and information platform** that combines:
- **Social networking** (accounts, feeds, posting, groups, real-time communication).
- **Information discovery** (news/events/trends, topic search, discussions/Q&A).
- **Personalization/ads** (targeted advertising with frequency caps and frustration reduction, while protecting privacy).
- **Trust, security, and reliability** (strong authentication/2FA, encryption, inauthentic-content filtering, outage reduction, acceptable performance).
- A related/adjacent capability for a **centralized “hub” / credential manager** experience (store credentials, auto-fill logins, aggregate content sources into a unified interface).

In short: it’s a “super-app” style feed + communities + Q&A + discovery + ads, with strong privacy/security, plus a centralized interface that can aggregate sources and help users sign into other services.

## Goal-by-goal meaning (with intended / not intended)

**g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
Intended: users can follow broad world news and what’s trending. Not intended: deep investigative journalism tooling.

**g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
Intended: chat/DMs/live messaging. Not intended: asynchronous-only messaging.

**g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
Intended: quick media posting/sending. Not intended: professional media editing suite.

**g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**  
Intended: status updates/check-ins. Not intended: full quantified-self tracking.

**g4 Explain what social content and posts are**  
Intended: onboarding/help content defining posts. Not intended: moderation policy.

**g5 Share non-verbal social updates**  
Intended: reactions, emojis, quick signals. Not intended: long-form posts.

**g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed**  
Intended: prioritization/filtering by person. Not intended: guaranteed exhaustive retrieval forever.

**g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
Intended: ability to interact without revealing identity. Not intended: enabling abuse; doesn’t negate platform rules.

**g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations**  
Intended: access controls, secure storage/transport. Not intended: “no data ever processed”.

**g9 Find answers to questions or issues**  
Intended: Q&A/help discovery. Not intended: official legal/medical advice accuracy guarantees.

**g10 View responses to a specific question**  
Intended: see answers thread. Not intended: authoring answers.

**g11 Help other people by answering their questions**  
Intended: contribute answers. Not intended: mandatory participation.

**g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience**  
Intended: expert/peer discovery by experience tags. Not intended: background checks.

**g13 Request that an interviewer repeat a question**  
Intended: interview-assist interaction feature (clarification prompt). Not intended: full interview automation.

**g14 Find a recipe**  
Intended: search/browse recipes. Not intended: meal planning with nutrition compliance.

**g15 Locate nearby places in a city where a specific item can be obtained**  
Intended: local search/marketplace-like discovery. Not intended: guaranteed inventory accuracy.

**g16 Receive advertisements tailored to intended purchases**  
Intended: ad targeting to likely intent. Not intended: targeting using private conversations (see g46).

**g17 Purchase an item**  
Intended: commerce checkout/transaction flow. Not intended: full ERP.

**g18 Get recommendations for top restaurants in a city**  
Intended: rankings/recs. Not intended: reservations system (unless added later).

**g19 Limit the number of times a person is shown advertisements for the same product**  
Intended: frequency capping. Not intended: removing all ads.

**g20 Join groups based on shared interests**  
Intended: communities membership. Not intended: enterprise access control groups.

**g21 Ask questions within interest-based groups**  
Intended: group Q&A. Not intended: global site-wide Q&A only.

**g22 Provide an explanation of what groups are**  
Intended: onboarding for groups. Not intended: group governance tooling.

**g23 Learn about news and events happening in a different location**  
Intended: location-based news. Not intended: travel booking.

**g24 Learn about technology news**  
Intended: category news. Not intended: developer documentation.

**g25 Prevent anyone other than the account owner from accessing the account.**  
Intended: account security. Not intended: protecting against device-level compromise entirely.

**g26 Prevent user-generated posts from disappearing unless the user deletes or archives them.**  
Intended: content persistence. Not intended: immutable content (user can delete/archive).

**g27 Ensure users do not miss relevant content items while browsing.**  
Intended: ranking/UX to surface important items. Not intended: forcing attention to all content.

**g28 Ensure users remain aware of major events.**  
Intended: major-event highlighting/alerts. Not intended: personalized emergency services.

**g29 Reduce the frequency of service outages.**  
Intended: reliability/availability engineering. Not intended: zero downtime guarantee.

**g30 Load new items within an acceptable time frame.**  
Intended: performance SLAs for feeds/pages. Not intended: offline-first.

**g31 Automatically populate all required information.**  
Intended: autofill for forms (likely account creation/login). Not intended: guessing sensitive values unsafely.

**g32 Create an account**  
Intended: registration. Not intended: anonymous-only usage.

**g33 Access an account**  
Intended: sign in. Not intended: passwordless only.

**g34 Explain what an account is**  
Intended: onboarding definition. Not intended: policy/terms.

**g35 Prevent loss of account details**  
Intended: recovery and secure storage. Not intended: user never forgetting anything.

**g36 Provide a backup code after account creation for use in two-factor authentication.**  
Intended: 2FA recovery codes. Not intended: bypassing authentication generally.

**g37 Store backup and access information securely for future use.**  
Intended: secure storage for codes/keys. Not intended: plain text storage.

**g38 Require and accept a backup code to authenticate sign-ins from new devices or to start new web sessions.**  
Intended: step-up auth. Not intended: prompting every single login always.

**g39 Maintain an authenticated session until the user logs out.**  
Intended: session persistence. Not intended: infinite session ignoring security timeouts (though not specified).

**g40 Allow users to authenticate to an account using a login control after being logged out.**  
Intended: login UI. Not intended: social login necessarily.

**g41 Build customer trust**  
Intended: reputation/retention via security/privacy/reliability. Not intended: marketing-only.

**g42 Enforce strong user authentication, including two-factor authentication when required**  
Intended: password + 2FA policies. Not intended: forcing 2FA in all cases (unless “required”).

**g43 Ensure communications are strongly authenticated**  
Intended: prevent spoofing/impersonation (signed sessions, verified senders). Not intended: end-to-end encryption explicitly (though may relate).

**g44 Detect and filter inauthentic content**  
Intended: anti-bot/spam/misinformation signals. Not intended: perfect moderation.

**g45 Encrypt data at rest and in transit**  
Intended: TLS + storage encryption. Not intended: necessarily E2EE for chats.

**g46 Prevent targeted advertising based on private conversations or personal activity**  
Intended: ad targeting must not use private comms or sensitive activity. Not intended: banning contextual ads entirely.

**g47 Limit repetitive ads by capping how often ads on the same topic are shown and stopping them after they are skipped**  
Intended: frequency + skip feedback loop. Not intended: eliminating ads.

**g48 Use contextual decision-making to avoid selecting ads based on a single mention of a topic**  
Intended: reduce false positives in targeting. Not intended: never using context.

**g49 Maintain a balanced amount of advertising to reduce frustration and prevent user churn**  
Intended: ad load management. Not intended: ad-free experience.

**g50 Stay informed about global events and trends**  
Intended: user-level outcome of news tracking. Not intended: professional analytics.

**g51 Laugh at memes**  
Intended: entertainment outcome. Not intended: content creation tooling.

**g52 Browse a home feed of posts**  
Intended: core feed browsing. Not intended: only search-based discovery.

**g53 Discover interesting posts while browsing**  
Intended: recommendations/surfacing. Not intended: guaranteed relevance.

**g54 View a discussion thread for a selected topic or item**  
Intended: open a thread page. Not intended: create threads.

**g55 Read the conversation within a discussion thread**  
Intended: view replies. Not intended: reply posting.

**g56 Continuously load additional feed content while scrolling without lag**  
Intended: infinite scroll performance. Not intended: pagination-only.

**g57 Refresh the feed to load new items at the top without requiring scrolling back to the top**  
Intended: pull-to-refresh/top refresh. Not intended: auto-refresh mid-scroll.

**g58 Search for information about a topic**  
Intended: keyword/topic search. Not intended: general web search necessarily.

**g59 Find discussions and questions about a topic**  
Intended: search within Q&A/discussions. Not intended: news-only.

**g60 Store and organize user credentials for multiple online accounts.**  
Intended: credential manager vault concept. Not intended: sharing passwords publicly.

**g61 Guide new users through adding their credentials.**  
Intended: onboarding for vault setup. Not intended: forced import.

**g62 Enable faster sign-in by selecting saved credentials and automatically filling login fields.**  
Intended: autofill login forms. Not intended: bypassing MFA.

**g63 Know what is happening in their friend circle, including friends in India**  
Intended: friend network updates with geo-relevance. Not intended: surveillance.

**g64 Know what is happening in the local area**  
Intended: local news/events feed. Not intended: emergency alerts system.

**g65 Receive updates about campus activities and events**  
Intended: campus community updates. Not intended: official university system integration.

**g66 Receive updates about class activities and coursework**  
Intended: class-related announcements. Not intended: full LMS.

**g67 Receive updates about classmates' activities and communications**  
Intended: peer updates. Not intended: grade reporting.

**g68 Search for and find the desired content**  
Intended: overarching discoverability goal. Not intended: only one search modality.

**g69 Browse an assortment of content rather than a single stream**  
Intended: multiple feeds/categories. Not intended: chronological-only.

**g70 Navigate to and explore a specific channel or group to discover desired content**  
Intended: navigation IA. Not intended: mandatory group membership.

**g71 View a diverse variety of content rather than repeatedly seeing similar content**  
Intended: diversity in recommendations. Not intended: random irrelevant content.

**g72 Avoid misinformation and update my beliefs based on verified facts**  
Intended: trustworthy info, verification cues. Not intended: absolute truth determination.

**g73 Provide a customizable centralized interface for accessing a user's preferred online services and content.**  
Intended: “hub” UI aggregating services/sources. Not intended: replacing those services.

**g74 Add preferred content sources to a single interface**  
Intended: connect sources. Not intended: scraping without permission.

**g75 View aggregated content from multiple sources in one place**  
Intended: unified feed/dashboard. Not intended: editing content across services.

**g76 Customize the interface to access preferred content sources**  
Intended: personalization of hub. Not intended: deep theming.

**g77 Access content from a single unified interface to avoid switching between multiple tools**  
Intended: reduce context switching. Not intended: single sign-on necessarily.

The goals describe a **social/content platform** (social network + discussion/Q&A + groups + news feed + ads) with **account security and privacy**, plus a **separate-but-related “unified interface / credential manager” capability** that lets users aggregate content sources and store credentials for faster sign-in across services. Users browse a home feed, discover posts/memes, track global/local/campus/class events, ask/answer questions (including in groups), and receive advertising with controls to avoid over-targeting or repetition. The platform aims to be reliable, fast, and trustworthy (strong auth, encryption, filtering inauthentic content, privacy protections).

## Goal-by-goal meaning (in this application)

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
  Meaning: Users consume global news/trends through feeds/search. Not intended: producing journalism; it’s consumption/awareness.

- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
  Meaning: Real-time chat/DM or live messaging. Not intended: asynchronous posting only; implies immediacy.

- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
  Meaning: Post/send media quickly to friends. Not intended: professional editing or long-form hosting.

- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**  
  Meaning: Status updates/check-ins/story-like posts. Not intended: formal blogging.

- **g4 Explain what social content and posts are**  
  Meaning: Onboarding/help content defining “posts/content.” Not intended: content moderation policy.

- **g5 Share non-verbal social updates**  
  Meaning: Reactions, stickers, emojis, GIFs, etc. Not intended: full text communication.

- **g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed**  
  Meaning: A person-centric feed/view (profile feed, following feed). Not intended: algorithmic discovery only.

- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
  Meaning: Ability to participate without revealing real identity (pseudonyms/anonymous posting). Not intended: bypassing abuse controls entirely.

- **g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations**  
  Meaning: Privacy/security controls against unauthorized access. Not intended: hiding data from the platform itself (unless specified).

- **g9 Find answers to questions or issues**  
  Meaning: Q&A/discussion search and consumption. Not intended: official customer support guarantee.

- **g10 View responses to a specific question**  
  Meaning: Open question detail and see answers/comments. Not intended: editing answers.

- **g11 Help other people by answering their questions**  
  Meaning: Users contribute answers. Not intended: expert certification.

- **g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience**  
  Meaning: Find knowledgeable users to message/ask. Not intended: verified credentials.

- **g13 Request that an interviewer repeat a question**  
  Meaning: Interview-assist feature (live interview tool, prompts). Not intended: auto-answering interview questions.

- **g14 Find a recipe**  
  Meaning: Search content for recipes. Not intended: grocery ordering.

- **g15 Locate nearby places in a city where a specific item can be obtained**  
  Meaning: Local search/discovery. Not intended: delivery logistics.

- **g16 Receive advertisements tailored to intended purchases**  
  Meaning: Some ad targeting based on purchase intent signals (contextual/allowed signals). Not intended: targeting using private conversations (see g46).

- **g17 Purchase an item**  
  Meaning: Commerce flow (in-app checkout or external links). Not intended: full marketplace operations necessarily.

- **g18 Get recommendations for top restaurants in a city**  
  Meaning: Local recommendations content. Not intended: reservations.

- **g19 Limit the number of times a person is shown advertisements for the same product**  
  Meaning: Frequency capping per ad/product. Not intended: removing ads entirely.

- **g20 Join groups based on shared interests**  
  Meaning: Group/community membership. Not intended: forming legal organizations.

- **g21 Ask questions within interest-based groups**  
  Meaning: Group-scoped Q&A/posts. Not intended: private 1:1 necessarily.

- **g22 Provide an explanation of what groups are**  
  Meaning: Onboarding/help for groups. Not intended: community guidelines.

- **g23 Learn about news and events happening in a different location**  
  Meaning: Location-based news feed/topic browsing. Not intended: travel booking.

- **g24 Learn about technology news**  
  Meaning: Topic-specific news consumption. Not intended: training courses.

- **g25 Prevent anyone other than the account owner from accessing the account.**  
  Meaning: Account security requirement. Not intended: preventing the owner themselves from losing access (covered by recovery goals).

- **g26 Prevent user-generated posts from disappearing unless the user deletes or archives them.**  
  Meaning: Persistence/durability of posts. Not intended: immutable storage if user deletes.

- **g27 Ensure users do not miss relevant content items while browsing.**  
  Meaning: Feed UX that surfaces relevant items (ranking, “new posts,” notifications). Not intended: guarantee of seeing everything.

- **g28 Ensure users remain aware of major events.**  
  Meaning: Breaking news/trending surfacing. Not intended: emergency alert system.

- **g29 Reduce the frequency of service outages.**  
  Meaning: Reliability/availability engineering. Not intended: 100% uptime.

- **g30 Load new items within an acceptable time frame.**  
  Meaning: Performance SLA for feed/search loading. Not intended: instantaneous always.

- **g31 Automatically populate all required information.**  
  Meaning: Autofill defaults or pulled profile data during flows (signup/posting/forms). Not intended: guessing sensitive fields incorrectly.

- **g32 Create an account**  
  Meaning: Signup. Not intended: guest-only use.

- **g33 Access an account**  
  Meaning: Login/sign-in. Not intended: account recovery (though related).

- **g34 Explain what an account is**  
  Meaning: Onboarding/help for accounts. Not intended: legal terms.

- **g35 Prevent loss of account details**  
  Meaning: Recovery/backup so users don’t lose access. Not intended: preventing compromise (g25).

- **g36 Provide a backup code after account creation for use in two-factor authentication.**  
  Meaning: Give recovery codes. Not intended: replacing 2FA.

- **g37 Store backup and access information securely for future use.**  
  Meaning: Secure storage for backup codes/credentials. Not intended: storing plaintext.

- **g38 Require and accept a backup code to authenticate sign-ins from new devices or to start new web sessions.**  
  Meaning: Step-up auth/2FA using backup code for new sessions. Not intended: requiring backup code every time.

- **g39 Maintain an authenticated session until the user logs out.**  
  Meaning: Session persistence. Not intended: infinite sessions regardless of risk.

- **g40 Allow users to authenticate to an account using a login control after being logged out.**  
  Meaning: Standard login UI. Not intended: SSO necessarily.

- **g41 Build customer trust**  
  Meaning: Overall trustworthiness via security, privacy, reliability. Not intended: marketing only.

- **g42 Enforce strong user authentication, including two-factor authentication when required**  
  Meaning: Password policies + 2FA support/enforcement. Not intended: forcing 2FA for all always.

- **g43 Ensure communications are strongly authenticated**  
  Meaning: Verify sender authenticity; prevent spoofing/impersonation. Not intended: encryption (that’s g45).

- **g44 Detect and filter inauthentic content**  
  Meaning: Anti-bot/spam/disinfo operations. Not intended: subjective censorship of opinions.

- **g45 Encrypt data at rest and in transit**  
  Meaning: TLS + storage encryption. Not intended: end-to-end encryption unless specified.

- **g46 Prevent targeted advertising based on private conversations or personal activity**  
  Meaning: Privacy constraint on ad targeting signals. Not intended: banning contextual ads.

- **g47 Limit repetitive ads by capping how often ads on the same topic are shown and stopping them after they are skipped**  
  Meaning: Frequency cap + skip feedback. Not intended: removing all ads.

- **g48 Use contextual decision-making to avoid selecting ads based on a single mention of a topic**  
  Meaning: Prevent overly sensitive targeting. Not intended: no targeting at all.

- **g49 Maintain a balanced amount of advertising to reduce frustration and prevent user churn**  
  Meaning: Ad load tuning. Not intended: maximizing ad revenue at all costs.

- **g50 Stay informed about global events and trends**  
  Meaning: User’s “why” behind g0/g28. Not intended: local-only awareness.

- **g51 Laugh at memes**  
  Meaning: Entertainment consumption. Not intended: creating memes (though possible).

- **g52 Browse a home feed of posts**  
  Meaning: Main scrolling feed. Not intended: search-driven only.

- **g53 Discover interesting posts while browsing**  
  Meaning: Recommendation/discovery in feed. Not intended: explicit search.

- **g54 View a discussion thread for a selected topic or item**  
  Meaning: Open a thread page. Not intended: composing posts.

- **g55 Read the conversation within a discussion thread**  
  Meaning: Consume comments/replies. Not intended: participation (separate goals).

- **g56 Continuously load additional feed content while scrolling without lag**  
  Meaning: Infinite scroll performance. Not intended: pagination-only.

- **g57 Refresh the feed to load new items at the top without requiring scrolling back to the top**  
  Meaning: Pull-to-refresh / “new posts” affordance. Not intended: auto-refresh mid-scroll.

- **g58 Search for information about a topic**  
  Meaning: Search capability. Not intended: browsing-only.

- **g59 Find discussions and questions about a topic**  
  Meaning: Search results scoped to threads/Q&A. Not intended: finding products/places (though possible via other goals).

- **g60 Store and organize user credentials for multiple online accounts.**  
  Meaning: Password manager-like feature. Not intended: identity provider.

- **g61 Guide new users through adding their credentials.**  
  Meaning: Onboarding wizard for credential storage. Not intended: auto-import everything without consent.

- **g62 Enable faster sign-in by selecting saved credentials and automatically filling login fields.**  
  Meaning: Autofill/login assist. Not intended: bypassing MFA on third-party sites.

- **g63 Know what is happening in their friend circle, including friends in India**  
  Meaning: Social awareness of friends’ updates, including remote friends. Not intended: global news generally.

- **g64 Know what is happening in the local area**  
  Meaning: Local events/news content. Not intended: hyper-accurate real-time alerts.

- **g65 Receive updates about campus activities and events**  
  Meaning: Campus-centric feed/channel. Not intended: official university systems integration.

- **g66 Receive updates about class activities and coursework**  
  Meaning: Class announcements-like content. Not intended: LMS replacement.

- **g67 Receive updates about classmates' activities and communications**  
  Meaning: Social/classmate updates. Not intended: graded communications.

- **g68 Search for and find the desired content**  
  Meaning: General information retrieval across content types. Not intended: guarantee of correctness.

- **g69 Browse an assortment of content rather than a single stream**  
  Meaning: Multiple feeds/channels/categories. Not intended: one chronological feed only.

- **g70 Navigate to and explore a specific channel or group to discover desired content**  
  Meaning: Drill into communities/channels. Not intended: algorithmic-only discovery.

- **g71 View a diverse variety of content rather than repeatedly seeing similar content**  
  Meaning: Diversity in recommendations. Not intended: forcing irrelevant content.

- **g72 Avoid misinformation and update my beliefs based on verified facts**  
  Meaning: Trust/verification + credible sourcing. Not intended: guaranteeing truth of all user speech.

- **g73 Provide a customizable centralized interface for accessing a user's preferred online services and content.**  
  Meaning: “Hub”/portal start page. Not intended: only internal content.

- **g74 Add preferred content sources to a single interface**  
  Meaning: Add sources/connect accounts. Not intended: scraping without permission.

- **g75 View aggregated content from multiple sources in one place**  
  Meaning: Unified reader/aggregator. Not intended: editing external sources.

- **g76 Customize the interface to access preferred content sources**  
  Meaning: Layout/pinning/prioritizing. Not intended: deep theming necessarily.

- **g77 Access content from a single unified interface to avoid switching between multiple tools**  
  Meaning: User value of hub. Not intended: replacing all tools’ functionality.

The goals describe a **social, content, and information platform** that combines: (a) a social network/newsfeed (posts, friends, groups, memes, media sharing), (b) Q&A/discussion threads and topic search, (c) **personalization and advertising** with privacy constraints and frequency caps, (d) **account creation/login + strong authentication**, and (e) a **“hub”/aggregator** experience that can pull content from multiple sources plus (f) a **credential manager** that stores logins for multiple online accounts and auto-fills them. Non-functional goals cover reliability, performance, privacy/security, content integrity, and user trust.

## Goal-by-goal meaning (in this application)

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
  Meaning: users can monitor worldwide developments and what’s trending on the platform. Not intended: detailed investigative journalism features; it’s about tracking/consuming.

- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
  Meaning: live messaging/chat-like interaction. Not intended: asynchronous-only communication.

- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
  Meaning: quick media posting/sending to friends. Not intended: professional editing/production workflows.

- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**  
  Meaning: status updates/check-ins/life updates. Not intended: formal blogging.

- **g4 Explain what social content and posts are**  
  Meaning: onboarding/help text defining posts/content. Not intended: moderation policy detail.

- **g5 Share non-verbal social updates**  
  Meaning: reactions, emojis, stickers, GIFs, etc. Not intended: long-form text communication.

- **g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed**  
  Meaning: prioritization/filtering so a chosen person’s newest content appears readily. Not intended: guaranteeing *only* that person’s posts.

- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
  Meaning: allow pseudonymous interaction, limited identity exposure. Not intended: enabling abuse; doesn’t imply no accountability.

- **g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations**  
  Meaning: confidentiality/access control for data/messages. Not intended: eliminating all data processing (some processing may still occur legitimately).

- **g9 Find answers to questions or issues**  
  Meaning: user can get help/solutions via Q&A/discussions/search. Not intended: professional/guaranteed correctness.

- **g10 View responses to a specific question**  
  Meaning: open question and see answers. Not intended: advanced ranking/analytics (unless implied elsewhere).

- **g11 Help other people by answering their questions**  
  Meaning: contribute answers. Not intended: obligation or expert verification.

- **g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience**  
  Meaning: find knowledgeable users to contact (career/interview context). Not intended: formal recruiting tooling.

The goal list describes a **consumer social/content platform** that combines: (a) a social feed for posts (photos/videos, daily updates, memes, groups, threads), (b) news/trends discovery, (c) Q&A/discussion search and participation, (d) ads and ad-governance, (e) strong account security/privacy, and (f) a *separate but related* “unified interface” capability that aggregates content/services and can also act like a **credential vault + autofill** experience.

In other words: users browse a home feed, discover content (including news, trends, and local/campus/class updates), communicate and post to friends/groups, ask/answer questions, and the system monetizes with ads while protecting privacy and maintaining trust. Separately, the product also aims to unify/aggregate multiple online services/content sources into one customizable interface and speed access via stored credentials.

## Goal-by-goal meaning (in this application context)

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
  Means users can monitor what’s happening broadly (news + trends) through the product. Not intended: deep investigative journalism production tools.

- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
  Means real-time chat/DMs or live interactions. Not intended: asynchronous-only messaging as the primary mechanism.

- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
  Means quick media posting/sending. Not intended: professional editing, long-form media production.

- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**  
  Means status updates/check-ins/short posts. Not intended: detailed quantified-self tracking.

- **g4 Explain what social content and posts are**  
  Means in-product education/onboarding/help text defining posts. Not intended: content moderation policy detail.

- **g5 Share non-verbal social updates**  
  Means reactions, stickers, GIFs, emojis, etc. Not intended: full text posts (covered elsewhere).

- **g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed**  
  Means personalization/following so a person’s newest posts appear quickly. Not intended: guaranteeing *only* that person’s posts.

- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
  Means support for anonymous/psuedonymous participation. Not intended: hiding from platform security/abuse handling.

- **g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations**  
  Means privacy/security controls. Not intended: preventing *authorized* platform functions (e.g., delivering messages).

- **g9 Find answers to questions or issues**  
  Means Q&A functionality (search + view + ask/answer). Not intended: official expert/legal/medical guarantees.

- **g10 View responses to a specific question**  
  Means open a question and see answers. Not intended: generating answers automatically.

- **g11 Help other people by answering their questions**  
  Means users can contribute answers. Not intended: obligation to respond.

- **g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience**  
  Means find people with certain experience and message/ask them. Not intended: formal recruiting workflow.

- **g13 Request that an interviewer repeat a question**  
  Means a feature in an interview context (possibly practice/interview chat) to ask for clarification/repetition. Not intended: real-world enforcement.

- **g14 Find a recipe**  
  Means search/discover recipes via content/search. Not intended: meal planning, grocery automation.

- **g15 Locate nearby places in a city where a specific item can be obtained**  
  Means local search/discovery. Not intended: guaranteed inventory accuracy.

- **g16 Receive advertisements tailored to intended purchases**

## 1) What the software application is and does (from the goals)

The goals describe a **social/content platform with a home feed**, real-time communication, posting and group discussions, news/trends discovery, search/Q&A-style threads, and an **advertising system**. It also includes **account creation/login with 2FA and session management**, privacy/security features (encryption, preventing unauthorized access, limiting ad targeting based on private data), reliability/performance goals (fast loading, fewer outages, infinite scroll, refresh), and a separate-but-related capability that looks like a **credential manager / unified portal** that aggregates content sources and stores credentials for multiple services so users can access preferred services/content from one interface.

In short: a **feed-based social + news + discussion app** with groups, search, ads, and strong identity/security; plus a **unified interface/aggregator** and **saved-credentials autofill** features.

  Means the app helps users follow worldwide happenings and what’s currently popular. Not intended: deep investigative journalism or editorial oversight.

### 1) What the software application is and does (from the goals)

The goals describe a **multi-purpose, social content and information platform** that combines:
- a **social network** (posting, feeds, groups, real-time communication, memes),
- **news/trending discovery** (global/local/tech events, major events awareness),
- **Q&A/discussion threads** (ask/answer, view responses, topic discussions),
- **local discovery and commerce support** (find restaurants/recipes/nearby items, purchase items),
- an **advertising system** (targeting, frequency caps, balancing ads, privacy constraints),
- strong **account/security/privacy** capabilities (2FA, encryption, prevent unauthorized access, detect inauthentic content),
- and additionally a **credential manager / aggregator-style unified interface** (store credentials, autofill, aggregate content sources).

Overall, it functions like a **super-app** or **hub** that lets users consume and discover content, interact socially, ask questions, and manage identity/security—while also providing a unified interface and credential storage for external services.

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.**  
  Intended: users can monitor what’s happening worldwide and what’s trending on the platform. Not intended: deep investigative journalism; it’s primarily consumption/discovery.

- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time**  
  Intended: live chat/DMs, possibly live reactions. Not intended: asynchronous forum posting (that’s covered by threads/groups).

- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends**  
  Intended: quick media posting/sending in feed or messages. Not intended: professional media editing suite.

- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends**

  Intended: person-centric feed view or prioritization. Not intended: guaranteeing *all* posts appear (ranking may still apply).

- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications**  
  Intended: ability to interact without revealing real identity (pseudonyms, anonymous posting in some contexts). Not intended: evading accountability for abuse; governance is unspecified.

The goals describe a **social/content aggregation application** that combines: (a) a social network feed (posts, stories/non‑verbal updates, groups, real‑time chat), (b) Q&A/discussion threads and topic search, (c) news discovery (global, local, location-based, tech), (d) ads/monetization with user-frustration controls, and (e) strong account/security/privacy features. There is also a **“centralized interface” / aggregator** capability for pulling content from multiple sources and even storing credentials for multiple online accounts (a launcher/portal + password manager–like behavior).

Below, each goal means in this context (and what it does *not* mean):

- **g0 Track global news, events, and trending topics.** User wants to follow worldwide happenings inside the app; not limited to friends’ posts.
- **g1 Communicate with friends in real time** In-app synchronous messaging; not necessarily video calling unless added.
- **g2 Share photos and videos instantly with friends** Quick media posting/sending; not professional editing.
- **g3 Share daily activity updates with friends** Status updates/check-ins; not formal blogging.
- **g4 Explain what social content and posts are** Onboarding/help copy; not content moderation.
- **g5 Share non-verbal social updates** Reactions, stickers, emojis, “story”-like signals; not long text.
- **g6 View the latest posts from a specific person when opening a social feed** Feed ordering/personalized entrypoint; not a full profile browse requirement.
- **g7 Maintain anonymity during online interactions and communications** Optional pseudonymity; not necessarily end-to-end anonymity against the platform operator.
- **g8 Protect privacy by preventing unauthorized access to or use of personal data and conversations** Privacy/security controls; not “no data collection at all.”
- **g9 Find answers to questions or issues** Q&A/search intent; not only within friend network.
- **g10 View responses to a specific question** Thread viewing; not authoring answers.
- **g11 Help other people by answering their questions** Contribute answers; not required for all users.
- **g12 Search for people with relevant interview experience to ask about their experience** Discover experts/people; not guaranteed they respond.
- **g13 Request that an interviewer repeat a question** Interview-assistance UX; not speech-to-text accuracy guarantees beyond that.
- **g14 Find a recipe** Information search; not grocery delivery.
- **g15 Locate nearby places in a city where a specific item can be obtained** Local search; not navigation turn-by-turn unless added.
- **g16 Receive advertisements tailored to intended purchases** Targeted ads; not necessarily based on private conversations.
- **g17 Purchase an item** Commerce conversion; not necessarily handled fully in-app vs. redirect.
- **g18 Get recommendations for top restaurants in a city** Recommendations; not guaranteed “best” objectively.
- **g19 Limit the number of times a person is shown advertisements for the same product** Frequency capping; not eliminating all ads.
- **g20 Join groups based on shared interests** Community feature; not automatic enrollment.
- **g21 Ask questions within interest-based groups** Group Q&A posts; not global Q&A.
- **g22 Provide an explanation of what groups are** Onboarding/help; not group governance policy.
- **g23 Learn about news and events happening in a different location** Location-based news; not travel booking.
- **g24 Learn about technology news** A vertical channel; not only hardware reviews.
- **g25 Prevent anyone other than the account owner from accessing the account.** Account security outcome; not necessarily anonymity.
- **g26 Prevent user-generated posts from disappearing unless the user deletes or archives them.** Persistence; not preventing users from deleting.
- **g27 Ensure users do not miss relevant content items while browsing.** Feed UX to surface relevant items; not guaranteeing they read everything.
- **g28 Ensure users remain aware of major events.** Breaking news surfacing; not political neutrality guarantees.
- **g29 Reduce the frequency of service outages.** Reliability; not zero downtime.
- **g30 Load new items within an acceptable time frame.** Performance; not instant for all networks.
- **g31 Automatically populate all required information.** Form autofill; not guessing sensitive info.
- **g32 Create an account** Signup flow; not social graph import.
- **g33 Access an account** Login; not account recovery.
- **g34 Explain what an account is** Onboarding/help.
- **g35 Prevent loss of account details** Recovery/backup; not preventing user forgetting entirely.
- **g36 Provide a backup code after account creation for use in two-factor authentication.** 2FA backup; not primary OTP delivery.
- **g37 Store backup and access information securely for future use.** Secure storage; not plaintext.
- **g38 Require and accept a backup code to authenticate sign-ins from new devices or to start new web sessions.** Step-up auth; not every login.
- **g39 Maintain an authenticated session until the user logs out.** Session management; not indefinite if security policies expire.
- **g40 Allow users to authenticate to an account using a login control after being logged out.** UI support for re-login; not SSO necessarily.
- **g41 Build customer trust** Stakeholder outcome; not directly implementable without refinements.
- **g42 Enforce strong user authentication, including two-factor authentication when required** Auth policy; not only passwords.
- **g43 Ensure communications are strongly authenticated** Integrity/authenticity (who said what); not necessarily encrypted (that’s g45).
- **g44 Detect and filter inauthentic content** Anti-spam/bots/deepfakes; not perfect truth detection.
- **g45 Encrypt data at rest and in transit** Security control; not guaranteeing E2EE specifically.
- **g46 Prevent targeted advertising based on private conversations or personal activity** Ads privacy constraint; not banning all ads.
- **g47 Limit repetitive ads by capping how often ads on the same topic are shown and stopping them after they are skipped** Ad fatigue control; not eliminating targeting.
- **g48 Use contextual decision-making to avoid selecting ads based on a single mention of a topic** Reduce overfitting; not no targeting.
- **g49 Maintain a balanced amount of advertising to reduce frustration and prevent user churn** Monetization balance; not ad-free experience.
- **g50 Stay informed about global events and trends** User outcome; more “why” than g0.
- **g51 Laugh at memes** Entertainment; not only news.
- **g52 Browse a home feed of posts** Primary feed entrypoint; not necessarily chronological.
- **g53 Discover interesting posts while browsing** Discovery/recommendations; not guaranteed relevance.
- **g54 View a discussion thread for a selected topic or item** Thread navigation; not authoring.
- **g55 Read the conversation within a discussion thread** Consume comments; not necessarily reply.

- **g59 Find discussions and questions about a topic** Search vertical; not general web.

- **g62 Enable faster sign-in by selecting saved credentials and automatically filling login fields.** Autofill; not bypassing MFA.
