## Goal-by-goal meaning (in this app’s context)

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**: The top-level purpose for users: they want to watch video for fun and/or learning. Not intended: non-video media, or planning tasks unrelated to viewing.
- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**: In-app clip previews that prevent bouncing between apps. Not intended: full episodes; also not a cross-device OS-level feature—just within this app experience.
- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**: Users can see when/where a title will be available (or leaving). Not intended: production schedules/filming news unless tied to availability in catalogs.
- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**: Users want to avoid extra paid services; app helps by surfacing where they already have access or free options. Not intended: piracy or bypassing paywalls.
- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**: A genre-specific instance of entertainment watching. Not intended: exclusive focus of the whole product; just one preference.
- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**: “Pick something for me” functionality (recommendation/matchmaking). Not intended: social/dating matching.
- **g6 View more information about a show**: Detail page (synopsis, cast, seasons, ratings, availability). Not intended: deep editorial reviews unless included as info.
- **g7 See recommendations for shows similar to a selected or currently watched show**: Similar-items rail based on the current context. Not intended: generic trending list only.
- **g8 Receive multiple show options to choose from based on viewing preferences**: A set/list of candidates tailored to preferences. Not intended: only one recommendation.
- **g9 Find where a show is available to watch across viewing platforms**: Aggregated availability across services. Not intended: actually providing subscriptions; it’s discovery/aggregation.
- **g10 Consume content to obtain information**: The “information” side of g0 (documentaries, news clips, educational). Not intended: reading articles or podcasts unless treated as video.
- **g11 Receive personalized content recommendations based on individual preferences and current mood**: Personalization incorporating mood context. Not intended: clinical mood detection; likely user-provided or inferred lightly.
- **g12 Browse recommended content**: UI/feeds to explore recommendations. Not intended: searching a specific title (that’s g22).
- **g13 Maintain stable content recommendations over time**: Avoid chaotic/overly volatile recs; continuity so users trust the system. Not intended: never changing recommendations.
- **g14 Start playing selected video content with minimal user steps**: Low-friction playback start (deep links, one-click play). Not intended: eliminating all confirmations (e.g., maturity ratings) if needed.
- **g15 Play a selected episode immediately after a preview clip ends**: Seamless transition from preview to playback. Not intended: autoplaying without user intent if they didn’t select it.
- **g16 Preview video content before deciding to watch it**: General preview capability (not necessarily short clips across genres). Not intended: mandatory preview before play.
- **g17 Use a smooth and convenient user interface**: UX quality goal enabling browsing, previews, playback. Not intended: a specific UI style—just low friction.
- **g18 Filter and browse shows and movies by genre or category to choose what to watch**: Discovery via categories/filters. Not intended: only recommendations; it’s user-driven exploration.
- **g19 Recommend shows and movies based on viewing history and genre preferences**: A concrete personalization method. Not intended: mood-based inputs (that’s g11) unless combined.
- **g20 Browse short clips across genres to help decide what to watch**: “Clips feed” (TikTok-like previews) across categories. Not intended: only clips from a single show.
- **g21 Save videos to watch later**: General watch-later behavior. Not intended: downloading for offline unless specified.
- **g22 Search for specific media titles**: Title search. Not intended: discovery browsing (g18/g12).
- **g23 Add media titles to a watch-later list**: Specific operation supporting g21. Not intended: saving arbitrary clips only; implies titles.
- **g24 Remove media titles from a watch-later list**: Manage watch-later list. Not intended: deleting account history.
- **g25 Indicate preference for a media title**: Like/dislike/rating to tune recommendations. Not intended: public reviews necessarily.
- **g26 Allow users to update their profile information**: Profile management (name, preferences, maybe parental settings). Not intended: billing management unless added.
- **g27 Allow users to switch the active user profile**: Multi-profile experience (household). Not intended: multi-account admin.
- **g28 Improve user retention**: Business goal: keep users coming back. Not intended: dark patterns; should be achieved via value/UX.

### 1) What the software application is and does

This code describes a **video-discovery and viewing companion app** (think: a streaming UI + cross-platform availability finder). Users can **browse and preview short clips**, **get personalized recommendations**, **search and filter titles**, **save items to a watchlist**, and **play content with low friction** (including resuming playback). The app also supports **multiple user profiles** and aims to **retain users** by keeping recommendations stable and the experience consistent.

A notable feature is **availability-aware watchlisting**: the system tracks when watchlist items are leaving a platform, notifies users ahead of time, prioritizes expiring items, and nudges users to watch before they lose access—helping them avoid needing an additional subscription elsewhere.

Some goals at the end (Mother’s Day planning, assisting an interviewer, enjoying themselves, playing games) appear **out of scope** for this app and read like stray placeholders.

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**  
  Means: overarching user objective—use the app to watch video for fun and learning.  
  Not: producing content or social media posting.

- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**  
  Means: preview inside the app; avoid bouncing between apps.  
  Not: full episodes; not necessarily cross-device.

- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**  
  Means: see where/when a title will be available (and possibly when it leaves).  
  Not: production schedules or theatrical release tracking unless integrated.

- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**  
  Means: steer user to already-subscribed/free options; prevent surprise paywalls.  
  Not: the app pays for subscriptions or pirates content.

- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**  
  Means: a specific entertainment intent; comedy as a use case.  
  Not: only comedy content.

- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**  
  Means: the system helps pick a title (recommendation/matching flow).  
  Not: guarantee the user will like it.

- **g6 View more information about a show**  
  Means: metadata like synopsis, cast, ratings, platform, etc.  
  Not: behind-the-scenes production management.

  Means: “because you watched X” similarity recommendations.

  *Not intended:* generic trending lists only.

This is a cross-platform video discovery and watching assistant (a streaming “hub”) that helps users decide what to watch by browsing previews/short clips, getting personalized recommendations, and quickly starting playback on the chosen platform. It also supports watchlists, availability tracking (including upcoming availability and expiring items), and continuity features (resume playback/progress). ### 2) Goal-by-goal meaning (in this application context)

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**  
  *Means:* The core user outcome: users consume video for fun and/or learning.  
  *Not intended:* Producing content; social networking; non-video media.

- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**  
  *Means:* In-app preview clips that help decide while staying in the app (even if playback happens elsewhere).  
  *Not intended:* Full episodes; requiring opening each streaming service app to preview.

- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**  
  *Means:* See when titles will arrive on platforms.  
  *Not intended:* Production schedules; theater releases; non-streaming availability.

- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**  
  *Means:* Help users find included-with-current-subscription options and avoid paywalls.  
  *Not intended:* Piracy; bundling subscriptions; actually providing free access.

- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**  
  *Means:* A specific entertainment intent that the system can support via genre filtering and recommendations.  
  *Not intended:* Creating comedy; live events.

- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**  
  *Means:* System narrows choices and suggests a good pick (decision support).  
  *Not intended:* Random choice with no rationale; only one fixed suggestion always.

- **g6 View more information about a show**  
  *Means:* Detail page (synopsis, cast, seasons, ratings, where to watch).  
  *Not intended:* Editorial reviews necessarily; spoilers; external wiki replacement.

- **g7 See recommendations for shows similar to a selected or currently watched show**  
  *Means:* “More like this” and similarity-based suggestions.  
  *Not intended:* Only global trending; ignoring current context.

- **g8 Receive multiple show options to choose from based on viewing preferences**  
  *Means:* Provide a set/list of candidates personalized to the user.  
  *Not intended:* Single forced choice; unpersonalized catalog lists.

- **g9 Find where a show is available to watch across viewing platforms**  
  *Means:* Availability aggregation by service, including subscription vs rent/buy.  
  *Not intended:* Deep-linking guaranteed for every service; guaranteeing prices.

- **g10 Consume content to obtain information**  
  *Means:* Informational viewing intent (documentaries, educational content).  
  *Not intended:* News publishing; fact-checking beyond recommending content.

- **g11 Receive personalized content recommendations based on individual preferences and current mood**  
  *Means:* Recommendations adapt to profile + explicit/implicit mood context.  
  *Not intended:* Medical/mental health diagnosis; invasive surveillance.

- **g12 Browse recommended content**  
  *Means:* UI to scroll/explore recommended rows/lists.  
  *Not intended:* Only search; no browsing experience.

- **g13 Maintain stable content recommendations over time**  
  *Means:* Avoid erratic swings; keep continuity in personalization.  
  *Not intended:* Never changing; ignoring new interests forever.

- **g14 Start playing selected video content with minimal user steps**  
  *Means:* Few taps from decision to playback (including deep links).  
  *Not intended:* Removing confirmation when needed; autoplay everything.

- **g15 Play a selected episode immediately after a preview clip ends**  
  *Means:* Seamless transition from preview to full playback if user chooses.  
  *Not intended:* Autoplay full episode without user consent.

- **g16 Preview video content before deciding to watch it**  
  *Means:* General preview capability (trailers, clips).  
  *Not intended:* Mandatory preview for all playback.

- **g17 Use a smooth and convenient user interface**  
  *Means:* Fast, low-friction UX across main flows (browse, preview, play, save).  
  *Not intended:* Specific design aesthetic; gamification.

- **g18 Filter and browse shows and movies by genre or category to choose what to watch**  
  *Means:* Discovery via facets (genre, category).  
  *Not intended:* Only genre; no personalization.

- **g19 Recommend shows and movies based on viewing history and genre preferences**  
  *Means:* Recommendation method using history + genres.  
  *Not intended:* Mood-based only; non-personalized trending only.

- **g20 Browse short clips across genres to help decide what to watch**  
  *Means:* TikTok-like clips feed across categories.  
  *Not intended:* Full catalog browsing without clips; only one genre feed.

- **g21 Save videos to watch later**  
  *Means:* Watchlist capability broadly.  
  *Not intended:* Downloading content; offline viewing.

- **g22 Search for specific media titles**  
  *Means:* Title search (shows/movies).  
  *Not intended:* People search; full-text within subtitles.

- **g23 Add media titles to a watch-later list**  
  *Means:* Add to watchlist.  
  *Not intended:* Adding arbitrary URLs.

- **g24 Remove media titles from a watch-later list**  
  *Means:* Remove from watchlist.  
  *Not intended:* Deleting account data wholesale.

- **g25 Indicate preference for a media title**  
  *Means:* Like/dislike/rate to tune recommendations.  
  *Not intended:* Public reviews; star-rating system specifically.

- **g26 Allow users to update their profile information**  
  *Means:* Manage profile preferences/settings.  
  *Not intended:* Identity verification; payment profile.

- **g27 Allow users to switch the active user profile**  
  *Means:* Multiple profiles in one account / household.  
  *Not intended:* Multi-account linking; SSO.

- **g28 Improve user retention**  
  *Means:* Business goal: keep users returning and engaged.  
  *Not intended:* Dark patterns; addictive mechanics as primary objective.

- **g29 Provide a consistent and familiar user experience over time**  
  *Means:* Avoid disruptive UI changes; stable interaction patterns.  
  *Not intended:* Never improving UI; blocking iteration.

- **g30 Sign out**  
  *Means:* Logout capability.  
  *Not intended:* Account deletion.

- **g31 Allow users to resume media playback from the last watched position**  
  *Means:* Continue watching across sessions/devices.  
  *Not intended:* Rewinding automatically; tracking beyond app scope.

- **g32 View an episode’s progress, including completion amount and current timestamp**  
  *Means:* Progress bar/metadata for episodes.  
  *Not intended:* Detailed analytics dashboards for users.

- **g33 Notify the user about watchlist items that will become unavailable about one month in advance.**  
  *Means:* Expiration alerts.  
  *Not intended:* Real-time legal guarantees; exact timing always perfect.

- **g34 Prioritize the user's watchlist based on how soon items will become unavailable.**  
  *Means:* Reorder/surface expiring items.  
  *Not intended:* Removing user control; hiding non-expiring items entirely.

- **g35 Prompt the user to start watching items before they become unavailable.**  
  *Means:* Nudges/reminders tied to expiration.  
  *Not intended:* Spam; coercive notifications.

- **g36 Help the user avoid having to pay to watch items elsewhere after they become unavailable.**  
  *Means:* Prevent “missed window” leading to rentals/new subscriptions.  
  *Not intended:* Price guarantees; negotiating deals.

- **g37 Fix minor issues**  
  *Means:* Maintenance/bugfixing to preserve UX.  
  *Not intended:* Major feature development.

- **g38 Plan a Mother's Day celebration for their mother**  
  *Means:* Unrelated to the video app; likely stray.  
  *Not intended:* Any video discovery function.

- **g39 Assist the interviewer**  
  *Means:* Unrelated stray goal.  

- **g40 Enjoy themselves**  
  *Means:* Very generic human goal; could loosely relate to entertainment, but too broad to refine here.  

- **g41 Play games occasionally, focusing on ones that look colorful and interesting.**  
  *Means:* Unrelated to core streaming hub (unless the app included games, which nothing else suggests).

### 1) What the software application is and does (from the goals)
This is a cross-platform video discovery and watching assistant (think: a “what should I watch?” hub) that helps a user:
- discover and decide on shows/movies using recommendations, browsing, search, and short preview clips,
- understand where a title is available (across streaming platforms) and what’s coming soon,
- start playback with minimal friction (including autoplay after preview and resume playback),
- manage a watch-later/watchlist (including alerts when items will leave availability),
- maintain a stable, familiar UI/experience over time to improve retention.

A few goals are clearly **out of scope / unrelated** to the application domain (Mother’s Day planning, “assist the interviewer”, playing games).

### 2) Goal-by-goal meaning (what each goal intends / does not intend)

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**  
  *Means:* overarching user objective: consume video for fun and/or learning.  
  *Not intended:* doesn’t specify how discovery/playback happens.

- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**  
  *Means:* in-app previews (snackable clips) that help decide without opening other apps.  
  *Not intended:* full episode playback; also not merely trailers on an external site.

- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**  
  *Means:* see future availability windows (release dates, when/where it will be watchable).  
  *Not intended:* general entertainment news unrelated to availability.

- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**  
  *Means:* guide user to options they already have (or free/ad-supported), avoiding extra paid subs.  
  *Not intended:* piracy or bypassing paywalls.

- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**  
  *Means:* a genre-specific instance of entertainment viewing.  
  *Not intended:* all viewing is comedy; it’s one user intent/segment.

- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**  
  *Means:* the system helps pick something (recommendation/matching workflow).  
  *Not intended:* purely manual browsing without system assistance.

- **g6 View more information about a show**  
  *Means:* details page: synopsis, cast, ratings, seasons, platform availability, etc.  
  *Not intended:* deep editorial content or reviews unless part of “more information”.

- **g7 See recommendations for shows similar to a selected or currently watched show**  
  *Means:* similarity-based recommendations seeded by a title the user chose/is watching.  
  *Not intended:* random trending lists not tied to a seed item.

- **g8 Receive multiple show options to choose from based on viewing preferences**  
  *Means:* provide a shortlist, not a single forced pick; based on user tastes.  
  *Not intended:* a single recommendation only.

- **g9 Find where a show is available to watch across viewing platforms**  
  *Means:* streaming availability aggregation across services.  
  *Not intended:* actually handling payment/subscription signup inside the app (unless later defined).

- **g10 Consume content to obtain information**  
  *Means:* “informational viewing” (documentaries, how-to, news).  
  *Not intended:* purely entertainment motivations.

- **g11 Receive personalized content recommendations based on individual preferences and current mood**  
  *Means:* personalization using profile/history plus a “mood” input/context signal.  
  *Not intended:* generic one-size-fits-all recommendations.

- **g12 Browse recommended content**  
  *Means:* UI flow to explore recommendation lists.  
  *Not intended:* search-only interaction.

- **g13 Maintain stable content recommendations over time**  
  *Means:* avoid wild fluctuations day-to-day; keep continuity and trust.  
  *Not intended:* never changing; it can evolve as taste changes.

- **g14 Start playing selected video content with minimal user steps**  
  *Means:* low-friction playback launch (deep links, one-click play).  
  *Not intended:* long multi-step confirmations.

- **g15 Play a selected episode immediately after a preview clip ends**  
  *Means:* seamless transition from preview to playback (autoplay / “continue to full”).  
  *Not intended:* always autoplay without consent; could be user-controlled.

- **g16 Preview video content before deciding to watch it**  
  *Means:* user can see preview before committing to full watch.  
  *Not intended:* only textual descriptions; specifically a preview experience (not necessarily “short clips across genres”—that’s g20).

- **g17 Use a smooth and convenient user interface**  
  *Means:* usability, speed, intuitive navigation.  
  *Not intended:* specific visual style unless tied to “consistent/familiar” goals.

- **g18 Filter and browse shows and movies by genre or category to choose what to watch**  
  *Means:* browse catalog/recommendations with filters/categories.  
  *Not intended:* only personalized feeds.

- **g19 Recommend shows and movies based on viewing history and genre preferences**  
  *Means:* core personalization inputs: history + genre affinity.  
  *Not intended:* mood-based logic (explicitly covered by g11).

- **g20 Browse short clips across genres to help decide what to watch**  
  *Means:* a “clips feed” spanning genres.  
  *Not intended:* clips only from one genre or only from titles already selected.

- **g21 Save videos to watch later**  
  *Means:* overall capability to bookmark content.  
  *Not intended:* offline downloads (not stated).

- **g22 Search for specific media titles**  
  *Means:* text search by title (possibly cast/keywords, but at least titles).  
  *Not intended:* recommendation/matching (that’s g5/g11/g19).

- **g23 Add media titles to a watch-later list**  
  *Means:* explicit add action to watchlist.  
  *Not intended:* automatic adds without user intent.

- **g24 Remove media titles from a watch-later list**  
  *Means:* manage and clean up watchlist.  
  *Not intended:* deleting viewing history.

- **g25 Indicate preference for a media title**  
  *Means:* like/dislike/rate to improve personalization.  
  *Not intended:* social sharing (not mentioned).

- **g26 Allow users to update their profile information**  
  *Means:* edit profile settings/preferences.  
  *Not intended:* account billing management (not specified).

- **g27 Allow users to switch the active user profile**  
  *Means:* multi-profile household support.  
  *Not intended:* impersonation/security flows beyond switching profiles.

- **g28 Improve user retention**  
  *Means:* business goal: keep users returning.  
  *Not intended:* any specific tactic; refinements define tactics.

- **g29 Provide a consistent and familiar user experience over time**  
  *Means:* UX continuity; reduces cognitive load and supports retention.  
  *Not intended:* never updating UI; updates can be gradual.

- **g30 Sign out**  
  *Means:* user can end session.  
  *Not intended:* account deletion.

- **g31 Allow users to resume media playback from the last watched position**  
  *Means:* continue watching; persistence of playback position.  
  *Not intended:* cross-device sync is implied but not guaranteed unless specified.

- **g32 View an episode’s progress, including completion amount and current timestamp**  
  *Means:* show progress UI (resume point, percent watched).  
  *Not intended:* detailed analytics beyond progress.

- **g33 Notify the user about watchlist items that will become unavailable about one month in advance.**  
  *Means:* “leaving soon” notifications for watchlist.  
  *Not intended:* notifications for all catalog items (only watchlist).

- **g34 Prioritize the user's watchlist based on how soon items will become unavailable.**  
  *Means:* ordering/ranking watchlist by urgency.  
  *Not intended:* removing items automatically.

- **g35 Prompt the user to start watching items before they become unavailable.**  
  *Means:* proactive nudges (“start now”) tied to unavailability deadline.

### 1) What the software application is and does (from the goals)

This goal model mostly describes a **video-discovery and viewing companion application** that helps users **decide what to watch**, **preview content**, **get personalized recommendations**, **find where a title is available across platforms**, and **manage a watch-later list**. It also supports **smooth playback** (resume, progress, minimal steps, autoplay after preview) and **account/profile actions**.

A smaller subset of goals (planning Mother’s Day, assisting an interviewer, playing games) appears **out of scope / unrelated** to the video app and looks like stray goals from other contexts; they do not refine or support the core video app goals.

### 2) What each goal means in this application context (and what it is not)

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**  
  *Means:* Top-level user objective: use video media to be entertained or informed.  
  *Not:* Not about producing content or social networking.

- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**  
  *Means:* In-app previews so users can evaluate content without leaving the app (even if the actual content is on another platform).  
  *Not:* Not necessarily full playback; specifically “short clips”.

- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**  
  *Means:* See when a title will become available (release windows, coming soon) and/or when it leaves services.  
  *Not:* Not a full calendar system unless needed.

- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**  
  *Means:* Help users find where they already have access (or free/ad-supported options) to avoid extra subscriptions.  
  *Not:* Not guaranteeing everything is free; it’s about avoiding unnecessary additional purchases.

- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**  
  *Means:* A specific entertainment objective (comedy) within the broader watching goal.  
  *Not:* Not the only genre supported.

- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**  
  *Means:* “Pick something for me” matchmaking based on preferences/context.  
  *Not:* Not necessarily social matching with other users.

- **g6 View more information about a show**  
  *Means:* Show detail pages: synopsis, cast, seasons, ratings, availability, etc.  
  *Not:* Not editorial articles unless required.

- **g7 See recommendations for shows similar to a selected or currently watched show**  
  *Means:* Similarity-based recommendations tied to a seed title.  
  *Not:* Not purely trending/global recommendations.

- **g8 Receive multiple show options to choose from based on viewing preferences**  
  *Means:* Present a set of candidates rather than a single forced pick.  
  *Not:* Not a single “best” result only.

- **g9 Find where a show is available to watch across viewing platforms**  
  *Means:* Cross-platform availability aggregation (Netflix/Hulu/etc.), including where it’s included vs. rent/buy.  
  *Not:* Not an actual platform subscription management tool.

- **g10 Consume content to obtain information**  
  *Means:* Informational viewing (news, documentaries, how-to).  
  *Not:* Not text-based learning resources.

- **g11 Receive personalized content recommendations based on individual preferences and current mood**  
  *Means:* Recommendations adapt to taste and “mood” context (explicit input or inferred).  
  *Not:* Not clinical mood detection; no requirement implied for sensitive inference.

- **g12 Browse recommended content**  
  *Means:* Explore recommendation feeds/rows/lists.  
  *Not:* Not necessarily search-driven.

- **g13 Maintain stable content recommendations over time**  
  *Means:* Avoid erratic recommendation churn; keep continuity so users can return and see consistent suggestions.  
  *Not:* Not freezing recommendations forever; stability with gradual updates.

- **g14 Start playing selected video content with minimal user steps**  
  *Means:* Reduce friction from selection to playback (deep links, one click).  
  *Not:* Not necessarily instant start if buffering/DRM constraints exist.

- **g15 Play a selected episode immediately after a preview clip ends**  
  *Means:* Seamless transition from preview to actual episode playback.  
  *Not:* Not autoplaying unrelated episodes without user intent.

- **g16 Preview video content before deciding to watch it**  
  *Means:* General preview capability (trailers/clips) to support decision-making.  
  *Not:* Not only “short clips across genres” (that’s g20).

- **g17 Use a smooth and convenient user interface**  
  *Means:* Low-friction UX: clear navigation, fast interactions, minimal confusion.  
  *Not:* Not defining a specific UI style.

- **g18 Filter and browse shows and movies by genre or category to choose what to watch**  
  *Means:* Browsing taxonomy, filters, categories.  
  *Not:* Not personalized recommendations (that’s g11/g19).

- **g19 Recommend shows and movies based on viewing history and genre preferences**  
  *Means:* Core personalized recommender using history and declared/implicit genre tastes.  
  *Not:* Not necessarily mood-based (that’s g11).

- **g20 Browse short clips across genres to help decide what to watch**  
  *Means:* A “clips feed” discovery mode spanning genres.  
  *Not:* Not tied to a single title’s preview only.

- **g21 Save videos to watch later**  
  *Means:* Watchlist functionality.  
  *Not:* Not offline downloading.

- **g22 Search for specific media titles**  
  *Means:* Title search across the catalog/aggregated sources.  
  *Not:* Not general web search.

- **g23 Add media titles to a watch-later list**  
  *Means:* Add action for watchlist.  
  *Not:* Not implicit auto-add.

- **g24 Remove media titles from a watch-later list**  
  *Means:* Remove action for watchlist.

The goals describe a **cross-platform video discovery and playback assistant** (think: streaming aggregator + recommendations + preview clips + watchlist + “where to watch” availability). It helps users decide what to watch by browsing short clips, getting personalized recommendations (including mood), viewing show info, and then starting playback with minimal steps—potentially deep-linking into the right platform without requiring extra subscriptions. It also manages a watch-later list and warns users when items are expiring from availability so they can watch before they need to pay elsewhere.

Several goals in the list are **out of scope** for this application as written: *Plan a Mother’s Day celebration*, *Assist the interviewer*, and *Play games occasionally…* don’t relate to video discovery/playback and appear to be stray items. I leave them unrefined.

## Goal meanings (in this application)

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**: Overall user objective to consume video. Not about creating content.
- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**: In-app previews that reduce hopping between services. Not full playback.
- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**: See future availability windows/coming soon. Not necessarily release calendars for theaters.
- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**: Find options within existing subscriptions/free sources. Not piracy; not guaranteeing zero cost.
- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**: A genre-specific instance of entertainment watching. Not exclusive to comedy.
- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**: System helps pick something. Not necessarily “the single perfect” choice.
- **g6 View more information about a show**: Metadata, synopsis, cast, ratings, etc. Not editorial reviews unless provided.
- **g7 See recommendations for shows similar to a selected or currently watched show**: Similarity-based recs. Not necessarily global “top picks”.
- **g8 Receive multiple show options to choose from based on viewing preferences**: A set of candidates, not just one. Not random suggestions.
- **g9 Find where a show is available to watch across viewing platforms**: Aggregation of providers and availability. Not executing payment/subscription changes.
- **g10 Consume content to obtain information**: Informational viewing (news/docs). Not reading articles.
- **g11 Receive personalized content recommendations based on individual preferences and current mood**: Personalization + situational context. Not mental-health diagnosis.
- **g12 Browse recommended content**: UI surfaces recs for exploration. Not necessarily searching.
- **g13 Maintain stable content recommendations over time**: Avoid chaotic recommendation shifts. Not preventing novelty entirely.
- **g14 Start playing selected video content with minimal user steps**: Quick play / deep link. Not necessarily auto-play without consent.
- **g15 Play a selected episode immediately after a preview clip ends**: Seamless transition from preview to playback. Not forced autoplay for all content.
- **g16 Preview video content before deciding to watch it**: General preview capability (trailers/clips). Not spoilers control.
- **g17 Use a smooth and convenient user interface**: Usability/performance. Not specific branding.
- **g18 Filter and browse shows and movies by genre or category to choose what to watch**: Faceted browsing. Not personalized ranking necessarily.
- **g19 Recommend shows and movies based on viewing history and genre preferences**: A concrete recommendation method. Not mood-based unless included.
- **g20 Browse short clips across genres to help decide what to watch**: Feed of clips spanning categories. Not only from one service.
- **g21 Save videos to watch later**: Ability to save for later. Not downloading/offline viewing by itself.
- **g22 Search for specific media titles**: Title search. Not semantic search by plot unless implemented.
- **g23 Add media titles to a watch-later list**: Create entries. Not share with others unless added.
- **g24 Remove media titles from a watch-later list**: Delete entries. Not archiving.
- **g25 Indicate preference for a media title**: Like/dislike/rate to tune recs. Not public social posting.
- **g26 Allow users to update their profile information**: Manage profile settings. Not identity verification.
- **g27 Allow users to switch the active user profile**: Multi-profile household use. Not multi-account merging.
- **g28 Improve user retention**: Business goal to keep users engaged. Not necessarily maximizing screen time at all costs.
- **g29 Provide a consistent and familiar user experience over time**: UX consistency across releases. Not blocking improvements.
- **g30 Sign out**: End session. Not account deletion.
- **g31 Allow users to resume media playback from the last watched position**: Continue watching across sessions/devices (where possible). Not guaranteed across external platforms unless integrated.
- **g32 View an episode’s progress, including completion amount and current timestamp**: Progress tracking display. Not necessarily analytics exports.
- **g33 Notify the user about watchlist items that will become unavailable about one month in advance.**: Expiration alerts for saved items. Not guaranteed accuracy if provider data missing.
- **g34 Prioritize the user's watchlist based on how soon items will become unavailable.**: Sorting/urgent cues. Not automatically starting playback.
- **g35 Prompt the user to start watching items before they become unavailable.**: Nudges. Not spam.
- **g36 Help the user avoid having to pay to watch items elsewhere after they become unavailable.**: Outcome of alerts/prioritization; not negotiating prices.
- **g37 Fix minor issues**: Maintenance/support. Not major feature work.
- **g38 Plan a Mother's Day celebration for their mother**: Out of scope for this app.
- **g39 Assist the interviewer**: Out of scope.
- **g40 Enjoy themselves**: Very high-level human goal; loosely connected to entertainment, but not operational.
- **g41 Play games occasionally, focusing on ones that look colorful and interesting.**: Out of scope.

## 1) What the software application is and does

The goals mostly describe a **video discovery and viewing assistant** (think: a streaming “hub” or companion app). It helps users **decide what to watch** using previews/short clips, **get personalized recommendations**, **search and browse by genre**, and **start playback with minimal friction**. It also supports a **watch-later/watchlist**, **cross-platform availability lookup** (where a show can be watched), and **unavailability awareness** (notify when watchlist items are leaving soon so users can watch in time and avoid paying elsewhere).

A few goals (Mother’s Day planning, assisting an interviewer, playing colorful games) do not fit this application; they appear to be unrelated/out-of-scope items in the initial list.

## 2) What each goal means (and does not mean) in this context

- **g0 Watch video content for entertainment and information**  
  Means: the overarching user objective of consuming video for fun and/or learning.  
  Not: creating content, social networking, or live broadcasting.

- **g1 Preview video content with short clips to decide what to watch without switching platforms**  
  Means: in-app previews so users don’t need to open multiple services to sample content.  
  Not: full episode playback necessarily; not replacing the underlying streaming services.

- **g2 View upcoming video content availability**  
  Means: see when/where content will become available (and possibly when it leaves).  
  Not: production schedules for filming; not theatrical releases unless included.

- **g3 Watch desired shows without needing to purchase an additional subscription**  
  Means: help users find options included in subscriptions they already have (or free/ad-supported options).  
  Not: piracy; not negotiating subscription prices.

- **g4 Watch comedy shows for entertainment**  
  Means: a genre-specific entertainment goal; supports filtering/recommendations.  
  Not: stand-up ticket purchasing; not creating comedy.

- **g5 Get matched with a show to watch**  
  Means: the system suggests a good candidate show given user needs/preferences.  
  Not: matching people to people (dating), or matching to movies only (shows are primary but could include movies).

- **g6 View more information about a show**  
  Means: show details like synopsis, cast, seasons, ratings, platform availability.  
  Not: behind-the-scenes production tools.

- **g7 See recommendations for shows similar to a selected or currently watched show**  
  Means: “more like this” recommendations driven by similarity.  
  Not: random discovery unrelated to current context.

- **g8 Receive multiple show options to choose from based on viewing preferences**  
  Means: provide a set of candidates (not just one) tailored to preferences.  
  Not: forcing autoplay of a single choice.

- **g9 Find where a show is available to watch across viewing platforms**  
  Means: cross-service availability (Netflix, Hulu, etc.) and possibly deep links.  
  Not: purchasing subscriptions directly.

- **g10 Consume content to obtain information**  
  Means: informational viewing (documentaries, news-like content) supported by discovery.  
  Not: reading articles; not necessarily interactive learning.

- **g11 Receive personalized content recommendations based on individual preferences and current mood**  
  Means: personalization includes stable preferences + situational “mood” input.  
  Not: clinical mood detection; not mental health diagnostics.

- **g12 Browse recommended content**  
  Means: UI surfaces recommendation rows/feeds to explore.  
  Not: only search-driven discovery.

- **g13 Maintain stable content recommendations over time**  
  Means: recommendations don’t fluctuate wildly day-to-day; predictable relevance.  
  Not: never changing; novelty can still be introduced.

- **g14 Start playing selected video content with minimal user steps**  
  Means: low-friction playback initiation (few clicks).  
  Not: zero authentication or bypassing parental controls.

- **g15 Play a selected episode immediately after a preview clip ends**  
  Means: seamless transition from preview to playback when user chooses.  
  Not: autoplay without user intent; not continuous autoplay of random items.

- **g16 Preview video content before deciding to watch it**  
  Means: trailers/clips/teasers shown before committing.  
  Not: spoilers-heavy summaries necessarily.

- **g17 Use a smooth and convenient user interface**  
  Means: usability, responsiveness, coherent navigation.  
  Not: defining a specific visual style.

- **g18 Filter and browse shows and movies by genre or category to choose what to watch**  
  Means: browsing taxonomy/genres, categories.  
  Not: editorial reviews.

- **g19 Recommend shows and movies based on viewing history and genre preferences**  
  Means: classic recommender using history + explicit/implicit prefs.  
  Not: mood-based (that’s g11), though could overlap.

- **g20 Browse short clips across genres to help decide what to watch**  
  Means: TikTok-like preview feed across categories.  
  Not: user-generated clip creation.

- **g21 Save videos to watch later**  
  Means: a watchlist/wishlist feature.  
  Not: offline downloading (not stated).

- **g22 Search for specific media titles**  
  Means: title-based search (and possibly cast/genre search).  
  Not: web search.

- **g23 Add media titles to a watch-later list**  
  Means: specific action to save items.  
  Not: bulk import unless implemented.

- **g24 Remove media titles from a watch-later list**  
  Means: manage the list by removing items.  
  Not: deleting content from the platform.

- **g25 Indicate preference for a media title**  
  Means: like/dislike/thumbs up to improve recommendations.  
  Not: star ratings necessarily, though could be.

- **g26 Allow users to update their profile information**  
  Means: edit profile details relevant to personalization (name, avatar, preferences).  
  Not: identity verification or payment settings unless added.

- **g27 Allow users to switch the active user profile**  
  Means: multi-profile support (household).  
  Not: multi-account billing.

- **g28 Improve user retention**  
  Means: keep users returning/engaged via good experience and relevance.  
  Not: dark patterns; not purely marketing emails.

- **g29 Provide a consistent and familiar user experience over time**  
  Means: stability in UX patterns; reduces learning costs.  
  Not: no improvements ever—just consistent evolution.

- **g30 Sign out**  
  Means: allow logout.  
  Not: account deletion.

- **g31 Allow users to resume media playback from the last watched position**  
  Means: continue watching across sessions/devices.  
  Not: skipping paywalls; requires access to content.

- **g32 View an episode’s progress, including completion amount and current timestamp**  
  Means: show progress bar/time; supports resuming and tracking.  
  Not: analytics dashboards for creators.

- **g33 Notify the user about watchlist items that will become unavailable about one month in advance.**  
  Means: leaving-soon notifications for watchlist items with a ~30 day lead.  
  Not: notifications for every catalog item, only watchlist.

- **g34 Prioritize the user's watchlist based on how soon items will become unavailable.**  
  Means: reorder/rank watchlist by urgency (leaving soon).  
  Not: changing what is in the watchlist without user action.

- **g35 Prompt the user to start watching items before they become unavailable.**  
  Means: call-to-action reminders to watch now.  
  Not: forced autoplay.

- **g36 Help the user avoid having to pay to watch items elsewhere after they become unavailable.**  
  Means: by alerting and prioritizing, help them watch before it leaves their included services.  
  Not: guaranteeing content remains free.

- **g37 Fix minor issues**  
  Means: continuous bugfixing and small improvements supporting smooth UX and retention.  
  Not: major redesigns.

- **g38 Plan a Mother's Day celebration for their mother** *(out of scope)*  
  Means: personal event planning; unrelated to video app.

- **g39 Assist the interviewer** *(out of scope)*  
  Means: interview support; unrelated.

- **g40 Enjoy themselves** *(too generic / out of scope)*  
  Means: general enjoyment; could be a super-goal but not specific to this system.

- **g41 Play games occasionally, focusing on ones that look colorful and interesting.** *(out of scope)*  
  Means: casual gaming; unrelated to video app.
